E0949

`T.reflect().values` needs an enum whose cases carry no payload

What

`T.reflect().values` needs an enum whose cases carry no payload

Why

`.values` lists every case of one enum type once as a value; a case with a payload is no value until its data is given, and any other type has no fixed set of values to list.

Fix

Read `.values` on an enum whose cases carry no payload, or list the values you need yourself.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0949: Tests/UI/e0949_enum_values_payload.stderr.

    |
 13 |     print(Shape.reflect().values.len())
    |                           ^^^^^^
 Why: `.values` lists every case once as a value, and a case with a payload is no value until its data is given
 Fix: Remove the payload from `Circle`, or list the values you need yourself
